panels.art: Wide diagonal chase shot down the soot-brown corridor: Dan and Mira run toward the camera, Dan wheezing; far behind them the Silent walks in a perfectly calm straight line, never faster, never slower. Vermilion lantern-words flicker on the walls as they pass.

lines.ru: Погоня продолжается. Безмолвный не бежит — он идёт. И не отстаёт ни на шаг.

lines.en: It walks! Why do we run?
lines.ru: Он идёт шагом! Почему мы бежим?
lines.delivery: breathless and frightened while running, voice shaking, incredulous question

lines.en: It is big. It is never tired.
lines.ru: Он большой. Он никогда не устаёт.
lines.delivery: clipped, breathless, flat warning, telling a cold truth while running

panels.art: Frontal wide shot of a blank dead end: a high wall of grey stone fills the frame; Dan and Mira skid to a halt in the foreground, backs to camera, dwarfed by the wall. Teal darkness creeps in from the corridor behind them.

lines.en: A wall! A big wall!
lines.delivery: panicked groan of despair, gasping as the corridor ends in a wall

lines.en: We are small. The wall is big.
lines.delivery: deadpan and grim, short and dry, stating the obvious with no hope

lines.ru: Тупик. Позади — ни звука, только тяжёлая, густая тишина. Безмолвные не топают. Они просто приближаются.

panels.art: Close-up on Dan's eyes behind the taped glasses, scanning; cut-in insert of the wall: a hair-thin seam, two rusted hinges and a keyhole hidden under grime, drawn like an engineer's blueprint in sharp detail. Mira watches him, sceptical.

lines.en: That is not a wall. That is a door.
lines.delivery: sudden quiet focus, slow and certain, the engineer recognizing a hidden seam

lines.en: How do you know?
lines.delivery: skeptical, low and curious, testing him with a raised eyebrow

lines.en: I know walls. I know doors.
lines.ru: Я знаю стены. Я знаю двери.
lines.delivery: calm confident engineer pride, steady and a little smug under pressure

lines.ru: Три года он рисовал стены и двери на чужих чертежах. Наконец-то это пригодилось.

panels.art: Insert shot: a small rusty key lying in the dust at the foot of the wall, a single glint of ochre light on its teeth; Dan's hand reaching in from the edge of the frame. Behind, Mira's boots, tense, half-turned toward the dark.

lines.en: A key! A small key!
lines.delivery: excited whispered shout, thrilled relief at spotting a tiny key

lines.en: That is a key. Wow.
lines.delivery: flat bored system remark, the word wow delivered with dry sarcasm

lines.ru: Кто-то уронил его здесь — и не вернулся за ним.

panels.art: Medium shot: Dan's trembling hands jam the key into the hidden lock; a small low door swings open in the wall revealing warm ochre light; Mira already shoving him in from behind, one glance over her shoulder at the approaching teal shadow.

lines.en: Open, open, open!
lines.delivery: frantic rapid chant, trembling hands, desperate and breathless

panels.art: Interior wide shot of a tiny round room in warm ochre light: Mira slams the small door and leans on it breathing hard, Dan collapses against the wall; in the middle of the ceiling hangs a bare lamp whose flame has a vermilion heart.

lines.ru: Дверца захлопывается. Тихо. Тепло. Под потолком горит лампа с красным сердечком пламени.

lines.en: This room is safe.
lines.delivery: exhausted relief, quiet and firm, catching her breath after slamming the door

lines.en: Why is a small room safe?
lines.delivery: puzzled and still panting, asking a childlike question

lines.en: The light is a word.
lines.delivery: calm and plain, a short strange fact said as if it were obvious

panels.art: Close-up of the lamp: a vermilion core inside an ochre flame, tiny letters curling in the fire; Mira's gloved hand points up at it while Dan, below, gazes at it with open mouth.

lines.en: Someone gives a word. The lamp burns.
lines.delivery: quiet, matter of fact explanation, low and measured by the warm lamp

lines.en: Silents stay out of the light.
lines.delivery: firm low statement, a simple rule of survival, almost proud

panels.art: Two-shot, intimate and warm: Dan slumps on an old mattress, Mira sits on a tin can across from him, unwrapping a cream scarf; steam of breath in the cool air. Dan gives a tired smile; Mira does not smile back.

lines.en: Thank you, Mira.
lines.delivery: warm, sincere and tired, a genuine thank you after a near death

lines.en: Not now. What is your name?
lines.delivery: brisk, deadpan, brushing off gratitude to get to business

panels.art: Close-up on Dan's face, mouth open, eyes searching; the lamp's glow trembles on his glasses; Mira blurred in the background, watching. A single thin vermilion thread of breath drifts from his lips and fades.

lines.en: I am... I am...
lines.delivery: stammering, lost and scared, searching for something that is no longer there

lines.ru: Он открывает рот. Слово не приходит. Там, где было имя, — пустое место.

lines.en: My name? What is my name?
lines.delivery: tiny trembling whisper, terrified inner voice, confused and fragile

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder from behind Dan: Mira's hard amber eyes fixed on him, her hand resting on the small door; the lamp throws her shadow huge on the wall.

lines.en: Word lost: DAN.
lines.delivery: cold flat system notice, soft and final, a quiet shock

lines.en: The Silent has your name.
lines.delivery: blunt and low, delivering the bad news without cushioning

lines.en: My name is gone! Give it back!
lines.delivery: anguished and desperate, voice cracking, half shouted plea

lines.en: It never gives. No name, no gate.
lines.ru: Он не отдаёт. Нет имени — нет прохода в ворота.
lines.delivery: cold, firm and final, a hard tower rule said with weary experience

panels.art: Medium two-shot with a flicker of dry humour: Mira points at Dan like an examiner, Dan folds his arms indignantly, the System window floats between them, tilted, deadpan.

lines.en: Zero words. No name. You are Zero.
lines.ru: Ноль слов. Нет имени. Ты — Зеро.
lines.delivery: dry and deadpan with a flicker of mischief, giving him a nickname like an examiner

lines.en: Zero is a good name.
lines.delivery: flat and polite, an ironic compliment delivered with dry system humor

lines.en: That is not funny.
lines.delivery: grumpy and sulking, arms folded, wounded pride

lines.en: A little.
lines.delivery: tiny dry admission, the faintest hint of a smile in her voice

panels.art: Wall detail: the ochre wall scratched all over with hundreds of names in different hands, some fresh, some faded to ghosts; Mira's thumb rests below one of them (lettering added later), Dan's finger traces another above it.

lines.en: What is that on the wall?
lines.delivery: quiet and curious, soft wonder at a wall covered with scratched names

lines.en: Names. People wait in this room.
lines.ru: Имена. Люди ждут в этой комнате.
lines.delivery: low and solemn, matter of fact and a little sad

lines.en: They wait. Then they are gone.
lines.delivery: hushed, hollow and grim, a heavy truth said very slowly

lines.ru: Мира проводит пальцем под одной из надписей и быстро убирает руку. Дэн замечает. Но молчит.

panels.art: Medium three-shot: Dan sits forward, Mira looks away to the lamp, the System window hangs in the middle, its border a little brighter than before.

lines.en: Why do you help me?
lines.delivery: gentle and sincere, a careful honest question in the warm lamplight

lines.en: One day. Then I am gone. Zero is useful.
lines.ru: Один день. Потом меня нет. Зеро полезен.
lines.delivery: flat, practical and guarded, hiding feeling behind a business-like answer

lines.en: Mira. Not now.
lines.delivery: short, warning, a mild reproach in a flat system voice

lines.en: Quiet, you.
lines.delivery: snappy, irritated, a sharp whisper at the System

panels.art: Low wide shot along the floor: the small door in the foreground, a thin line of teal shadow under it, and a slow patient knock; Dan and Mira frozen on the mattress, their faces lit from above by the lamp.

lines.ru: Снаружи стучат. Ровно. Терпеливо. Так стучат те, кому некуда спешить.

lines.en: Be quiet. This room is safe.
lines.delivery: tense whisper, very low and urgent, listening to something at the door

panels.art: Split composition: left, the door with the teal gap beneath; right, Dan's hand hovering an inch from the iron handle, his face torn between longing and fear; Mira's hand grips his wrist.

lines.en: Open the door. I am Dan.
lines.delivery: eerie hollow whisper, smooth and slightly wrong, mimicking Dan's voice to lure him

lines.en: No! That is not you! Stay in the light!
lines.ru: Нет! Это не ты! Оставайся на свету!
lines.delivery: sharp terrified whisper-shout, desperate to stop him from opening the door

lines.en: That is my voice. That is my name.
lines.ru: Это мой голос. Это моё имя.
lines.delivery: dazed, aching inner voice, stunned longing for his own stolen name

lines.ru: Дэн смотрит на ручку. Он так хочет вернуть себе имя — хоть так. Рука сама тянется вперёд.

panels.art: Wordless dramatic close-up: Mira's face draining of colour, amber eyes huge, her right hand clutching the frayed vermilion cord on her left wrist; at the edge of frame, the dark outline of the door.

lines.ru: И вдруг голос за дверью меняется. Теперь это голос ребёнка. Мира знает, чей он.

lines.en: Mira? Open the door. It is cold.
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, soft and cold, imitating Mira's sister's plea

lines.en: That is not... no.
lines.delivery: broken whisper, her voice shaking, grief tearing through her disbelief

grammarNote.title: This / that и a / the
grammarNote.body: This — то, что рядом («это»), that — то, что подальше («то, вон то»). Артикль a ставим, когда предмет новый («какой-то ключ»): «a key». Когда уже ясно, о каком предмете речь — ставим the: «the key». Если слово названо как слово, пишем его ЗАГЛАВНЫМИ: OPEN.

quiz.q: Что Дэн заметил в стене тупика?
Что случилось с Дэном, когда Мира спросила его имя?
Чей голос послышался из-за двери в конце?
